## About
Premier Collision is a body shop on Jamerson Road in Marietta, serving drivers across the greater Atlanta area. We handle everything from small dents and scratches to complicated collision work, with careful attention to matching your paint color exactly.
We also work on the bigger stuff. That means fleet vehicles, semi truck, RV and motorhome repair, fiberglass on campers and cars, bed liners for trucks, and vinyl decals we make in house.
Whether you're going through insurance or paying out of pocket, we'll work with you. Google reviewers rate us 4.5 from 39 reviews.

## Services
- Collision, dent and paint repair: Dent and scratch repair, complicated collision work and exact paint color matching.
- Fleet services: Auto body and PM services for fleets, with fleet discount rates. We also work with ARI Fleet Management Services.
- Fiberglass repair: Repair for damaged fiberglass on RV's, campers, cars and semi trucks.
- Vinyl decals: Vinyl decal services, with decals made right here in our shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies, and we also have self pay rates available.

Q: How much does an estimate cost?
A: Estimates are free. Stop in or contact us to get one.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Jamerson Road in Marietta, about 1 mile south of Hwy 92.
